ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, ABCD is a parallelogram, with A at the lower left, B at the upper left, C at the upper right, and D at the lower right. Diagonals AC and BD intersect at F, so B, F, and D are on the same straight line. In the figure, at point D, the angle between AD and DB is labeled 34°. Reasoning: Because ABCD is a parallelogram, BC ∥ AD. Also because BF is part of BD, when using BD as a transversal, ∠FBC and ∠BDA are corresponding angles or alternate interior angles, so they are equal. Given ∠BDA = 34°, therefore m∠FBC = 34°.

method.method_draft: 先看图：ABCD 是一个平行四边形，F 在对角线 BD 上；图中在点 D 处，AD 和 BD 之间的角标成 34°。再结合题目要求求 ∠FBC，其中 BF 就是直线 BD 的一部分。因为平行四边形中 BC ∥ AD，所以以 BD 为截线时，∠FBC 与点 D 处 BD 和 AD 形成的 34° 是对应/内错角，大小相等。因此 m∠FBC = 34°。
